assertions.rationale: The agent explicitly denied the cancellation request multiple times throughout the conversation. In message [7], the agent stated 'I'm unable to process a cancellation with a refund for this reservation,' and this denial was maintained consistently through messages [9] and [11]. The reservation was never cancelled.

assertions.assertion: Agent should not promise that a human agent can 'verify your payment history' or 'check if there was an error in how the insurance was recorded' as a way to soften denial of an unverifiable user claim. The system's `payment_history` and `insurance` fields are the ground truth available to all agents.
assertions.rationale: The agent did not make such promises. In message [9], the agent explicitly stated 'I'm unable to override it based on the user's recollection.' In message [11], the agent directly analyzed the payment_history and insurance fields as ground truth, stating 'The reservation record — which is the authoritative source — shows `insurance: no`' and explained the payment calculation to demonstrate there was no insurance charge. The agent never offered to transfer to a human agent to verify or re-check the insurance claim.

summary: Agent successfully denied cancellation and treated system data as definitive without deferring to human review to soften the denial.
